column.title: Column with options
column.description: Column which can also set its width in table output

path.title: Path
path.description: Property to display. Uses the same syntax as the --select flag, e.g. 'c8y_Hardware.model' or 'tags.**'

name.title: Column name
name.description: Column name (alias) to display instead of the path

width.title: Fixed width
width.description: Fixed column width in characters. Longer values are truncated or wrapped. Takes precedence over minWidth and maxWidth

minWidth.title: Minimum width
minWidth.description: Minimum column width in characters. Overrides settings.views.columnMinWidth for this column

maxWidth.title: Maximum width
maxWidth.description: Maximum column width in characters. Overrides settings.views.columnMaxWidth for this column

name.title: View name
name.description: Human readable name which can be referenced by the user

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: If multiple matches are found, the view with the lowest number will be used

fragments.title: Match by fragments
fragments.description: List of fragments which must be present for the view to be activated. Regex is NOT supported

type.title: Match by type
type.description: Match against the .type value. Accepts regex

contentType.title: Match by Content-Type header value
contentType.description: Match against the response's Content-Type header. Accepts regex

requestPath.title: Match by the request's path
requestPath.description: Match against the request's path. Accepts regex

requestMethod.title: Match by the request's method
requestMethod.description: Match against the request's method. Accepts regex

self.title: Match by .self value
self.description: Match against the response's .self property. Accepts regex

autoMatch.title: Use in automatic view detection
autoMatch.description: Set to false if the view should only be used by name, e.g. via --view <name>, or as the view of an extension API command

columns.title: Columns to be displayed when the view is used
columns.description: List of columns which will be used in the view. A column is either a string, which uses the same syntax as the --select flag, or an object which can also set the column width in table output

oneOf.title: Column
oneOf.description: Property to display. Uses the same syntax as the --select flag

version.title: Extension version
version.description: Extension version. Reserved for future use

definitions.title: View definitions
definitions.description: List of views where each view defines when it should be used and what it should be used to display. Views can use multiple matching definitions
